rule: One melee attack resolves damage; the damage message gets a punctuation tier from three cut points (weak, medium, strong), the top tier adding marks on a log scale. A trample-type attack pushes the defender one tile straight away from the attacker, stepping one tile at a time and stopping at walls, monsters, or constriction; a moved monster loses a few energy units so the push reads. After each attack, queued final effects fire: effects of the same kind merge when scheduled (blood and deferred damage add), and the queue fires from the back, removing each entry before it fires. Viewport shake is five blocking frames of random one-cell offsets at a fixed frame time, used only for big spell and god effects. Low-HP warning is a blocking red flash plus a message when HP crosses a percent of max. Every blocking delay is scaled by a view-delay option against a default constant.

data_fields.name: punct_scale_max
data_fields.unit: count of marks at top tier

data_fields.name: merge_rule
data_fields.unit: enum: same-kind merges into one entry

keep: Punctuation tier as a number-free damage read
Merge of same-kind feedback within one tick
Push stops at walls and monsters, no clipping through
Pushed creature loses its next beat (energy penalty)
Remove each queued entry before it fires, so nothing merges into a firing entry
Viewport jitter only for big effects, short and blocking
change: Fire the queue first-in first-out so the first of three hits lands first
Blocking flash only for low-HP warning and big effects, not normal hits
Shake is a tile jitter on the duel view, not a camera move
Donor blocking delays stay client-side; server tick keeps stepping
Low-HP warning threshold is our own data field
look_test: Ten-second clip, three attackers on one target, fight camera, 375 wide. Taps: A one merged beat per tick (shake, tier punctuation, push stops at walls); B each hit fires its own shake and flash; C text only, no shake (control). Dom judges which reads as one clear beat. Publish via the look-test /preview/ flag; no release rows.
